title: Hypothesis packet
description: One investigator's independent finding on one dimension of an incident. The contract exists to make INDEPENDENCE auditable: a packet must cite its own evidence in `sources`, and must declare in `derived_from` if it took its conclusion from a peer instead. synthesize-hypotheses.sh reads these fields to tell real corroboration from consensus theater.

dimension.description: The single dimension this investigator owns. It reasons over this dimension's evidence and no other.

root_cause.description: The cause this dimension's evidence supports, as one of a fixed set of labels. It is an ENUM and not free text on purpose: the synthesizer decides agreement by comparing these values, so two investigators who genuinely agree must emit the same string. Free-text causes make real agreement undetectable — every fan-out reads as a disagreement because no two agents phrase a cause identically. Put the prose in `sources`. Null when status is inconclusive.

status.description: Whether this dimension's own evidence supports, refutes, or cannot settle the hypothesis.

confidence.description: How strongly this dimension's evidence carries the conclusion. Must be justified by sources, not by how plausible the answer feels.

sources.description: The investigator's OWN evidence — commands it ran, files and lines it read. At least one is required; a packet with no sources is an opinion, and the synthesizer rejects it.

derived_from.description: Null when this conclusion came from this dimension's own evidence. Set to another dimension's name if the conclusion was taken from that peer — which the synthesizer rejects as consensus theater. Declaring it honestly is the point of the field.

missing.description: Evidence this investigator could not obtain, named so the synthesis can loop instead of concluding on partial data.
